items.title: Zay Flowers: Works on side field Thursday
items.description:
Flowers (hamstring) isn't practicing Thursday, though he worked out on his own prior to practice, Kyle Goon of The Baltimore Banner reports.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Status still muddled for Week 3
items.description:
Head coach Nick Sirianni said Thursday that he had no update on the status of Barkley (shoulder) heading into the Eagles' first practice of the week, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Rico Dowdle: Remains out of uniform Thursday
items.description:
Dowdle (toe) was out of his walking boot Thursday but wasn't in uniform at practice, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Jaylen Warren: Practicing again Thursday
items.description:
Warren (shoulder) was in uniform and participating during the portion of Thursday's practice open to the media, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

items.title: Nico Collins: Not practicing Thursday
